seatbelt.profileOverride:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(allow process-fork)
(allow process-exec)
(allow signal (target same-sandbox))
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow mach-lookup
    (global-name "com.apple.system.notification_center")
    (global-name "com.apple.system.logger")
    (global-name "com.apple.distributed_notifications@Uv3")
    (global-name "com.apple.CoreServices.coreservicesd")
    (global-name "com.apple.FSEvents"))
(allow file-read-metadata)
(allow file-read-data (literal "/"))
(allow file-read*
    (subpath "/bin") (subpath "/sbin") (subpath "/usr/bin") (subpath "/usr/sbin")
    (subpath "/usr/lib") (subpath "/usr/libexec") (subpath "/usr/share") (subpath "/System")
    (subpath "/Library") (subpath "/private/var/db/timezone") (subpath "/private/var/db/dyld")
    (subpath "/private/var/select") (subpath "/private/etc"))
(allow file-read* file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/zero") (literal "/dev/random") (literal "/dev/urandom"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "/dev/fd"))
(allow file-read* file-write* (subpath "/fixture/private/open"))
(allow network-outbound (remote ip "localhost:8444"))
(deny file-read* file-read-metadata file-write* file-write-create file-write-unlink network-bind network-outbound (require-all (subpath "/fixture/private") (require-not (subpath "/fixture/private/open")) (require-not (literal "/fixture/private"))))
(deny file-write* file-write-create file-write-unlink (regex #"^/fixture/private/open/(\.[aA][gG][eE][nN][tT][sS]|\.[aA][vV][eE]/[cC][oO][mM][mM][aA][nN][dD][sS]|\.[aA][vV][eE]/[hH][oO][oO][kK][sS])(/|$)"))
(deny file-write-create file-write-unlink (regex #"^/fixture/private/open/(\.[aA][vV][eE])$"))
(deny file-write-create file-write-unlink (regex #"/\.[gG][iI][tT]$"))
(deny file-write* (require-all (regex #"/\.[gG][iI][tT]$") (vnode-type REGULAR-FILE)))
(deny file-write* file-write-create file-write-unlink (regex #"/srt-sock-[^/]*(/|$)"))
